info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package catalogsync is the REVERSE half of the storefront loop: it consumes the commerce COMMERCE stream and turns each `commerce.product.created` into ONE content.EnsureCatalogAsset call, so a newly-created catalog product gets its ecom asset rendered (design == slug) — the mirror of the forward edge (apps/content storefront.go) that publishes a rendered asset back onto the product image.
